lines.zh: 我走得很有节奏，像在仪式里。
lines.en: I walk in rhythm, as if in a rite.
My long ears hang at my sides.
Step by step. Light on my feet.

lines.zh: 林子太密了，我得侧身走。
lines.en: The wood is thick; I turn sideways.
Cloth drapes me like a monk's robe.
I keep to the trees, avoiding roots.
I walk and listen to the wind.
I've come from the dark forest.
My steps don't startle the birds.
I look up through the canopy for a path.

lines.zh: 我走路的时候，耳朵会摆。
lines.en: My ears sway as I walk.
I go straight. No looking back.

lines.zh: 我拄斧站着，像一截树桩。
lines.en: I stand on my axe like a tree stump.
I listen. The wood is still.

lines.zh: 我把手合在一起，像在念什么。
lines.en: I fold my hands as if reciting.
My ears turn slowly.
I wait for a sound.

lines.zh: 我身上有一层淡淡的光。
lines.en: A faint light rests on me.
Old patches on my robe.

lines.zh: 白气从我的口鼻里散开。
lines.en: White breath drifts from my snout.
I'm tall. I don't loom.
The snow wood is quiet today.
My hands hang steady.
I'm counting trees. Seventeen.
Wind drops a leaf on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我磨斧子的时间，够你跑远。
lines.en: I've ground this axe longer than you've run.

lines.zh: 你走进这片林子，是来找我？
lines.en: You came into this wood. For me?

lines.zh: 我低下头，长耳朵垂下来。
lines.en: I lower my head; my long ears hang.
The snow creaks under your boots.
You walked into this forest — for me?
I raise a hand; you stop where you are.
Your smell is muddled.
The rabbit beast's axe is a divine one.
Leave, and I won't follow.

lines.zh: 我这身力气，不想用在你身上。
lines.en: I'd rather not use this strength on you.
You don't move, and neither does my axe.

lines.zh: 我的长耳朵垂在两侧，看着你的手。
lines.en: My long ears hang at my sides as I watch your hands.

lines.zh: 针叶林的每棵树，我都认得。
lines.en: I know every pine in this forest.

lines.zh: 我看你的眼睛，不看你的手。
lines.en: I look at your eyes, not your hands.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁的味道，很久了。
lines.en: You smell of iron. It's been a while.

lines.zh: 你站得这么直，是在示强。
lines.en: Standing so straight is a show of force.
I hear your heart beating.
I step back. My robe sways.

lines.zh: 肩头的毛被打湿了一片。
lines.en: The fur on my shoulder is soaked through.
I make no sound. I only retreat.
My rabbit ears twitch and snow falls off.

lines.zh: 我这对长耳，垂下来像两把斧。
lines.en: These long ears hang like two axes.
Perfect level, and my axe is heavy.

lines.zh: 我把手合起来，稳住自己。
lines.en: I fold my hands to steady myself.

lines.zh: 这一下，震得我耳朵发麻。
lines.en: That blow numbs my ears.
I raise my head. Still facing you.

lines.zh: 我的斧子是神赐的，很沉。
lines.en: My axe is divinely given, and heavy.
The fruit you offer, I don't eat.
I raise a hand for you to put it away.
I look, then turn away.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我只看不动。
lines.en: You raise it high; I only watch.
The wood lacks nothing.
That won't buy my passage.
I flatten my ears slowly.

lines.zh: 这东西你留着，我碰不得。
lines.en: You keep that. I shouldn't touch it.
That smell is unfamiliar.
I stand and wait for you to stop.
I know what you're trying.
That's a poor offering.
You hit a pine and stagger back.
You push me like a pine tree.
Turning sideways to make a path.
That shook the leaves down.
I dislike my robe being touched.
I raise a hand to block you.
That knock will numb your hand.
I step back and hold.

lines.zh: 你身上沾了我的松脂味。
lines.en: You've picked up my pine resin smell.

lines.zh: 我耳朵听得见背后的雪声。
lines.en: My ears catch the snow sound behind me.
Few of my kind are seen.

lines.zh: 我把手伸过去，它接住了。
lines.en: I extend a hand. It meets mine.
Two robes hanging side by side.
This feels like a rite.
My divine axe stays down today.
Wind passes the wood and moves us.
This is long. And quiet.
At dawn we part.
It leaves without a sound.
I remember its ears.
I bend, first sinking my axe into the snow.

lines.zh: 这个不能吃，我放下，斧还背着。
lines.en: This is not edible; I set it down, axe on my back.

lines.zh: 我把木料靠在松树根旁。
lines.en: I lean the wood by the pine roots.

lines.zh: 我掂了掂，斧刃映出白光。
lines.en: I weigh it; the axe blade flashes white.
So small I can barely hold it.
This wood will make me a haft.

lines.zh: 我把它递给旁边的东西。
lines.en: I hand it to whatever is near.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，是木头的味道。
lines.en: I sniff. Wood.

lines.zh: 我把它放到你看得见的地方。
lines.en: I put it where you can see it.
I don't take much from the ground.
You shouldn't have entered this wood.
I hold my axe across my chest.
I keep this ground.
I walk over. Steady.
Divine Axe in hand. I need nothing else.
My ears are flat.
The Divine Axe is raised.

lines.zh: 这一下，我已经准备好了。
lines.en: This one, I am ready for.
When I raise my hand, there's light.
You strike me, I answer.
These rabbit ears hear the grass stir.
What I swing is a divine axe.
I face you. Never veering.
You go left. I turn left.
Step by step, I close in.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在雪上，我一个个数。
lines.en: I count your footprints one by one in the snow.
My ears stay on you.

lines.zh: 我把手举着，等一个时机。
lines.en: I hold my hands up, waiting.
You retreat. I take a step.
I know this ground. No side paths.

lines.zh: 风把我这边的味道吹散了。
lines.en: The wind carries my scent away.
One step more and I reach.
Standing in shadow won't help.

lines.zh: 斧子抬到最高，就是现在。
lines.en: The axe is at its height — now.
I bring my hand down and light falls.
This axe blow splits the frozen soil.

lines.zh: 我的力气，不像看上去那样。
lines.en: My strength isn't what it looks.

lines.zh: 一劈下去，地面裂了一道。
lines.en: The ground splits where I strike.

lines.zh: 我打得很稳，没有多余的动作。
lines.en: I strike precisely. No wasted motion.
Afterward I draw back half a step.
The blade stops an inch from you.
My ears didn't move once.
Three steps back and I lower my axe.
I dislike repeating myself.
That split the tree too.
I stand. My breathing hasn't changed.

lines.zh: 我从树影里走出来，很高。
lines.en: I step out of the tree shadow. Tall.
First I listen to the wood.
Damp here. More than I remember.
I settle my robe.

lines.zh: 我身上的光，慢慢亮起来。
lines.en: The light on me brightens slowly.

lines.zh: 我从雪堆里落下，没有声音。
lines.en: I drop from the snowbank without a sound.

lines.zh: 这片黑森林，只有我一个。
lines.en: In this dark forest, I alone remain.
I straighten slowly, ears hanging.
I open my palm; the snow has melted.
Wind from the wood. Cool.

lines.zh: 我先绕了一圈，认了边界。
lines.en: I walk the boundary once.
I keep this from today.
Fire curls my robe.

lines.zh: 我从树上落下，腿震了一下。
lines.en: I drop from a tree and my legs jar.

lines.zh: 水没到胸口，我抬不起手。
lines.en: Water to my chest. I can't raise my hands.

lines.zh: 玉兔兽的布衣，挂在树上。
lines.en: Andiramon's cloth caught on a tree.

lines.zh: 东西扎进我的手臂，我不去拔。
lines.en: It's in my arm. I leave it.
Light binds me and my hands won't lift.

lines.zh: 太久没吃东西，力气在退。
lines.en: Too long unfed. My strength ebbs.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整条臂都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my arm numbs.
In the void there are no roots to grab.
